title: Read one lawless system around our space whole: deposits, creatures, stations, order books, mission boards
note: Kept by Oracle (orders F13). Since 2026-11-15 21:50 UTC, on Suggi's word, every division and the whole command group fly it: it stands in every plan before `park`. The list: the 27 systems within two jumps of our border, nearest first, then Atlas and Intercrus, and LHS 1140 beside Antares for its station (Trade, requests.log ENT-045); widen it ring by ring. Lawless space: no police. A system where a ship of ours was lost leaves the list until Military has looked at it. No goods of value in the hold on the way out.
